setup: Keep CN/variable, literal-entry OFF, ID legends. Every independent base/Shift cell begins with Clear, Shift unlit. Base: tap key, exact ASCII raw, empty output, no selection. Shift: first three quote keys each receive TWO consecutive Shift+key activations; local output must be alternating Chinese double quotes in either orientation, raw empty. Other three Shift cells use ONE Shift+key activation with mapped Chinese output. Clear cancels composition/output but does not reset quote pairing.
